desc: Hob Brackenridge, the farm's builder (docs/decisions/0011-farm-builder-tutorial.md). He stands by the market stall (and works at the house while it goes up); walk up and press interact to talk face to face ('talk'). Blueprints with a level or milestone in farm_build.json unlock for real only once Hob has drawn them up, so a level-up or milestone makes a 'new blueprints' toast and a mark over his head. Everything with no entry there is on offer from the start.
name: Hob Brackenridge

stand.desc: Metres in front of the house centre and to its right, so he never blocks the door (where he works while it is a site).

stall_stand.desc: Metres out in front of the market stall and to its side: where he waits.

lines.first: Name's Hob. I draw up what you can build. Start with a house, a patch, a pot and a pen, and I'll have more when the farm has grown.
lines.nothing: Nothing new yet. Grow the farm: harvest, hatch, scan, and make it out of an expedition.
lines.level_2: You've got a crew now. Let's give them something to swing at.
lines.level_3: Real work needs a real bench.
lines.level_4: Pens, kilns, a proper hospital. Now we're talking.
lines.level_6: Nothing left that I haven't drawn. Keep building.
lines.first_run: First run done. Take this blueprint: a Challenge House. Six wood and four stone, then it's yours.
lines.first_extract: You came back alive. Take this blueprint.
lines.first_boss: Bring me a trophy and I'll carve it in stone.
lines.scan3: Three Boki scanned? Then you'll want somewhere to put them.

menu_hint_empty: Hob has nothing new for you yet.

intro.text: There you are! I'm Hob Brackenridge. I build things.
This is your farm now. A bit bare, but we'll fix that.
That's the market stall. Sell what you grow, buy seeds.
First you need a house. That spot over there will do nicely.
A house needs wood. Here, take an axe and chop a tree.

offer.text: By the way... I see you found a {mask} Mask.
Could I interest you in another?

talk.offer_title: Pick one. It's yours to keep.
talk.offer_wait: No rush. I'll hold on to them.
talk.offer_taken: Good choice. Go on, put it on.

roles.juggernaut: Up close: a chained blade that hits hard.
roles.tender: Healer: her lantern keeps you and your Boki going.
roles.ashwick: Area: bottled fire that takes the ground.

talk.shows_doc: A line's show: stall, house (the house or its spot), tree (the nearest tree), portal. Hob points at it and the camera looks for show_s seconds, then comes back.
